hypotheses.topic: Integer interleaving of micro/nano futures fills
hypotheses.conditional_result: Peak common-factor exposure is minimized by the middle insertion. Under fixed size-independent waits, the variance-minimizing split is the nearest feasible integer to r*t_after/(t_before+t_after).
hypotheses.attack: Peak exposure reduction does not imply lower time-integrated risk, fees, margin or higher profit.

hypotheses.conditional_result: A union bound gives a conditional lower expected-value bound.
hypotheses.attack: Marginal fill rates do not determine joint execution PnL; a stop order does not prove a finite loss cap.

hypotheses.topic: Capital-feasible paths with adverse fill branches
hypotheses.conditional_result: Deterministic minimum starting capital is a bottleneck path problem.
hypotheses.attack: An affordable terminal portfolio or one successful path is not a robust execution policy.

hypotheses.conditional_result: Outward rounding around a shared simultaneous value cannot make an executable crossing.
hypotheses.attack: Last trades and midpoints are not executable bid/ask prices.

hypotheses.conditional_result: Four confirmed equal-quantity fills restore per-venue coin units and have an exact incremental cash identity.
hypotheses.attack: Reverse opportunity need not arrive by the deadline; seed inventory keeps directional exposure.

hypotheses.topic: Option payoff certificate implies fast cashout
hypotheses.conditional_result: A maturity payoff inequality does not bound the interim executable bid.
hypotheses.attack: A cash-payoff package can gain at maturity but lose on mandatory short-horizon liquidation.
